---
title: "Render all tutorials"
output: html_document
---

Knit this file, or run its chunks, to make the participants' sheet of every tutorial in `tutorials/`. The practical lectures (4, 6, 9 and 11) have a tutorial each, named like the lecture (`04_gamm_practical.Rmd`), with the lecture's title as `title` and `Tutorial 4` as `subtitle`. In class I use the slides of the practical lecture; the tutorial has the same tasks as exercises, for participants to work through on their own, and a last section that goes beyond the slides.

Each tutorial is written once, with its solutions, and this file makes:

- a check: the whole tutorial, solutions included, is knitted in a temporary folder, so every solution runs from top to bottom. Rendering stops at the first tutorial that fails, and the error names it;
- the participants' sheet, `docs/tutorials/04_gamm_practical.Rmd`: the same file without the solutions, with an empty chunk where each piece of solution code was.

In a tutorial, everything inside a `::: solution` block counts as solution, text included. Everything else appears on the sheet, including hints and code that participants get, such as a helper function or code with `___` to complete. Classes on headings, such as `{.smaller}`, are left out of the sheet. Unlike the Statistics tutorials, these have no slides of their own and no weekly assignment.

The sheets are also part of `{konstats}`, in `inst/sheets/advanced`, so that `konstats::get_tutorial(4, ".", course = "advanced")` copies them. After changing a tutorial, copy its sheet from `docs/tutorials` to the konstats repository.

## Reading a tutorial

`read_tutor()` splits a tutorial into its YAML header and its body. `classify()` records for each line of the body whether it belongs to a code chunk and to which solution block (0 for none), and it marks the lines that open or close a solution block.

```{r reading}
read_tutor <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, encoding = "UTF-8")
  fences <- which(lines == "---")
  list(yaml = lines[seq_len(fences[2])], body = lines[-seq_len(fences[2])])
}

classify <- function(body) {
  n <- length(body)
  chunk <- logical(n)
  sol <- integer(n)
  fence <- logical(n)
  in_chunk <- FALSE
  in_sol <- FALSE
  block <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    line <- body[i]
    if (!in_chunk && grepl("^:::+ *\\{?\\.?solution", line)) {
      block <- block + 1L
      in_sol <- TRUE
      fence[i] <- TRUE
      sol[i] <- block
      next
    }
    if (!in_chunk && in_sol && grepl("^:::+ *$", line)) {
      in_sol <- FALSE
      fence[i] <- TRUE
      sol[i] <- block
      next
    }
    if (grepl("^```", line)) {
      chunk[i] <- TRUE
      in_chunk <- !in_chunk
    } else {
      chunk[i] <- in_chunk
    }
    if (in_sol) sol[i] <- block
  }
  data.frame(line = body, chunk = chunk, sol = sol, fence = fence)
}

squeeze <- function(x) {
  blank <- x == ""
  x[!(blank & c(FALSE, head(blank, -1)))]
}
```

## The participants' sheet

Each solution block becomes one empty chunk if it contains code, and disappears if it is only text.

```{r sheet}
sheet_lines <- function(d) {
  out <- character(0)
  i <- 1
  while (i <= nrow(d)) {
    if (d$sol[i] > 0) {
      rows <- which(d$sol == d$sol[i])
      if (any(grepl("^```\\{r", d$line[rows]))) out <- c(out, "```{r}", "", "```")
      i <- max(rows) + 1
    } else {
      line <- d$line[i]
      if (!d$chunk[i] && grepl("^#+ ", line)) line <- sub(" *\\{[^}]*\\} *$", "", line)
      out <- c(out, line)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  squeeze(out)
}
```

## Making the sheets

`check_tutorial()` knits the full tutorial in a fresh R session, in a temporary folder, and stops with the name of the tutorial if anything fails. `make_tutorial()` runs the check and writes the sheet.

```{r make}
check_tutorial <- function(path) {
  tmp <- tempfile("tutorial_")
  dir.create(tmp)
  file.copy(path, tmp)
  ok <- tryCatch({
    xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render,
                       list(input = file.path(tmp, basename(path)), output_dir = tmp, quiet = TRUE))
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop(basename(path), " does not knit: ", ok, call. = FALSE)
}

make_tutorial <- function(path, out_dir) {
  check_tutorial(path)
  tutor <- read_tutor(path)
  sheet <- c(tutor$yaml, sheet_lines(classify(tutor$body)))
  target <- file.path(out_dir, basename(path))
  writeLines(sheet, target, useBytes = TRUE)
  target
}
```

```{r render, message = TRUE}
out_dir <- file.path("..", "docs", "tutorials")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
tutorials <- list.files("tutorials", pattern = "^[0-9]{2}_.*\\.Rmd$", full.names = TRUE)
for (tutorial in tutorials) {
  message("Checking and writing ", basename(tutorial))
  make_tutorial(tutorial, out_dir)
}
```

```{r rendered}
sheets <- file.path(out_dir, basename(tutorials))
knitr::kable(data.frame(sheet = basename(sheets), updated = format(file.mtime(sheets), "%d %b %Y %H:%M")))
```
